title: Muedzo weDombo Risina Kubereka
intro: Nharaunda, ine hunyanzvi uye inodada, yakaisa nhaka yavo mumakomo chaiwo. Asi pavakatumirwa chiratidzo chakajeka, muedzo wekutenda nekudzora, kuzvikudza kwavo kwakavatungamirira munzira isingadzokeri shure. Unogona kuziva boka iri nemhedzisiro yekusateerera kwavo here?
clues: Taiva nyanzvi dzematombo, tichiveza dzimba dzakanaka kwazvo mumakomo.
Mutumwa wevanhu vedu akauya kwatiri, achitidana kuti tinamate Mwari Mumwe Chete Wechokwadi.
Takakumbira chiratidzo chekusimbisa mashoko ake, uye chisikwa chakasiyana chakabudiswa semuedzo kwatiri.
Takapihwa murairo uri nyore: wekugovana mvura yedu nechisikwa ichi, tichichirega chichinwa pazuva racho.
Mukuzvikudza kwedu, vashoma pakati pedu vakarangana uye takaramba yambiro, tichiparadza chisikwa chaifanira kuva chiratidzo chedu.
Takapihwa mazuva matatu tisati tasvika pakuparadzwa, uye ipapo kuputika kukuru kwakatibata mudzimba dzedu, zvikatisiya tisisina upenyu uye takapidiguka.

location.label: Chii Chaiva Chinhu Chikuru Munyaya Yedu?

arabic: فَعَقَرُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةَ وَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰصَـٰلِحُ ٱئْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse: So they hamstrung the she-camel and were insolent toward the command of their Lord and said, "O Ṣāliḥ, bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the messengers." (7:77)
